title: Mount Vernon Indoor Air: Corridor Dust vs Household Debris
headline: Fort Hunt colonials, Hollin Hills metal, and why Parkway summers sweat at the trunks
description: Mt Vernon, VA sits along the GW Parkway on the Potomac. An educational look at why older river-side trunks collect humidity and pollen.

sections.heading: Wooded Fort Hunt lots hide long dryer runs
paragraphs: Dryer vents often travel a long exterior wall toward a rear cap in the trees. Lint packs where you cannot see it from the kitchen. That moisture dump feeds whatever is already growing on cool trunks.
If the first AC week after rain smells musty, when you are ready to book, use the [Mt Vernon, VA location page](/locations/mount-vernon).

sections.heading: Typical signs in a Mt Vernon house
listItems: Musty air from a rambler or colonial basement after a humid Parkway week.
Gray-green film on supplies in a Hollin Hills or Fort Hunt house.
A dryer that never quite finishes on a wooded-lot rear cap.

sections.heading: This is the Fairfax County community — not the estate gift shop
paragraphs: Fort Hunt, Waynewood, Stratford Landing, Hollin Hills, and Mount Vernon Woods sit along the George Washington Memorial Parkway. A lot of the housing is older than west-county HOAs: brick colonials, ramblers, and mid-century houses with original metal trunks. The Potomac is close. Summer air is wet. Basements and crawl spaces stay cool. Cold supplies sweat; river pollen and Parkway dust stick to that film.

Hollin Hills streets were never designed around oversized modern returns. Later central-air add-ons snake through tight joists. Dust collects at those kinks the way river fog sits on a windshield in July.

listItems: Dehumidify basements and crawls in summer even if the river breeze feels cool.
Change filters when parkway pollen is heavy.
Clean ducts every 3 to 5 years; clear long dryer runs about once a year.

faq.q: What usually causes gray film on supply registers?
faq.a: Fine particles that bypass or overload filters settle in cool trunks and recirculate when the blower runs.

faq.q: When is dryer vent cleaning the better first step?
faq.a: When laundry closets stay hot, dry times double, or you smell burnt lint — clear the vent to the exterior cap.
